print('TankTemperature unpacked:', tank_temp)

print('FillingStatus:', filling_status)

import struct

# The encoded bytes are 0000008000
# TankLevel is 16 bits, little endian, unsigned, at start 0
# TankTemperature is 16 bits, little endian, signed, at start 16
# FillingStatus is 4 bits, little endian, unsigned, at start 32

encoded = b'\x00\x00\x00\x80\x00'
print('Encoded bytes:', encoded.hex())

# TankLevel: bits 0-15 (bytes 0-1), little endian
tank_level_bytes = encoded[0:2]
print('TankLevel bytes:', tank_level_bytes.hex())
tank_level = struct.unpack('<H', tank_level_bytes)[0]
print('TankLevel unpacked:', tank_level)

# TankTemperature: bits 16-31 (bytes 2-3), little endian, signed
tank_temp_bytes = encoded[2:4]
print('TankTemperature bytes:', tank_temp_bytes.hex())
tank_temp = struct.unpack('<h', tank_temp_bytes)[0]
print('TankTemperature unpacked:', tank_temp)

# FillingStatus: bits 32-35 (byte 4), little endian
filling_status = encoded[4] & 0x0F
print('FillingStatus:', filling_status)
